full_response:
Bukidnon State University currently has a total of **16 campuses** (the **Main Campus** in Malaybalay City plus **15 Satellite Campuses**):
• **Within Bukidnon Province (12 campuses)**: Baungon, Cabanglasan, Damulog, Impasug-ong, Kadingilan, Kalilangan, Kitaotao, Libona, Malitbog, Quezon, San Fernando, and Talakag campuses.

1. **Main Pedestrian Entrance (Walking Entrance)**: Nahimutang sa atubangan, kini ang pultahan nga para lamang sa mga estudyante nga mosulod pinaagi sa paglakaw. *Pahibalo: Ang mga examinees para sa BukSU-CAT kinahanglan mosulod sa Exit Gate tungod kay kini ang pinakapaspas nga agianan padulong sa main examination building (College of Business / COB Building).*

3. **Campus Exit Gate**: Ang nag-inusarang pultahan para sa paggawas sa mga tawo ug mga sakyanan.

full_response:
Adding subjects is allowed during the first two weeks of the semester.
Dropping subjects is allowed until the midterm period with proper approval.
To add/drop, you must secure an Add/Drop Form from the Registrar's Office. or download it right here:
Adding: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1Gkc7oLA-gfrRNiO0eTYjfBdy51PqD7Ou

query: How many units can a freshman take in one semester?
response_preview: What is the maximum number of units a first-year student can take in their first semester? For incoming first-year students, your
full_response:
What is the maximum number of units a first-year student can take in their first semester?
For incoming first-year students, your course load is fixed and block-enrolled according to your degree program's approved curriculum/prospectus.
A regular first-year first-semester load typically ranges from **21 to 24 units** (including NSTP and PE).
First-year students are not permitted to take unit overloads or advance subjects, as overloads are strictly reserved for graduating students in their final academic year.

The Supreme Student Council (SSC) is the highest governing student body at BukSU, along with Local College Student Councils (LSC).

For inquiries and election guidelines, visit the SSC Office or the Office of Student Services (OSS).
